title: Android release build: emulator verification of the user-facing build
checklist: build the release variant (assembleRelease), note the APK name and signing state, verify embedded official-web + spike assets inside it
sign the unsigned APK locally with the debug keystore for verification only, and record that this is not the shipped artifact's state
plain launch (no extras, nothing staged) reaches the official DSH Web UI: screenshot + ZERO dsh.spike.log records, ZERO level:debug, ZERO level:info, no verdict text, no gateway-audit lines
the release build REFUSES an E2E drive by name (--ez dsh.llm true) rather than silently no-op-ing
contrast: dsh-android-harness (assembleDebug) on the same plain launch still emits the full E2E stream
evidence committed under hosts/android/artifacts/release-logging/ with a re-runnable run.sh (non-zero exit on violation) and MANIFEST.md
gov run green, PR opened and merged
